answer: Each clone enters the wharf as a vertex. A violet is one indivisible unit of locked capital leasing one future epoch: admission burns one violet and erases one epoch from every other attacker lease, including in the same batch. Thus N clones erase N−1 epochs per lease, and keeping them active for H epochs requires N(H+N−1) units of violet; parallel batches cannot avoid the erasures, and no violet can be split. A forged lease or captured wharf breaks it.
